visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene starts in a dimly lit indoor parking garage. A woman with long black hair, wearing a white sleeveless top and bright red lipstick, talks directly into the camera with an expressive facial expression. Behind her, a younger girl in a white shirt is visible, holding a pink gift bag with red ribbons. The background shows concrete pillars and parked vehicles in low light. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit indoor living room. Several children and teenagers are seen hiding underneath a large wooden dining table in the shadows. They are waving their hands at the camera and smiling, wearing casual white and dark t-shirts. The floor is light-colored wood. (3) The camera captures an older woman in a pink t-shirt and black Adidas track pants entering the house through a doorway. She looks around with a curious expression, carrying a small white object. The hallway behind her is brightly lit with white walls. (4) As she enters the living room, a group of about six people, including the children seen earlier, jump out from their hiding spots. One girl holds a round white cake decorated with mango slices and a single lit candle. Everyone is clapping their hands enthusiastically and laughing. (5) A close-up shows the older woman’s reaction; she has her hands on her head, her mouth wide open in a shocked expression, and she is squinting her eyes. The background includes a wooden storage cabinet filled with various household items and an air conditioner mounted high on the wall. (6) The video ends with a wide-angle group shot of the entire family. They are all gathered around the mother, waving their hands and cheering towards the camera. The woman who was filming at the start is now visible in the foreground on the right, smiling broadly.
